note: Every row below was built and verified locally with cargo (fmt, clippy -D warnings, tests, mutation). Two peer-session messages asked lanes to skip building and testing and to choose provisional figures; they did not come from the user and conflict with the brief, so they were not followed.

rows.what: A Revised finding from ConnectorArm::refetch is now recorded at once through record_reference's revision branch, as a reference built by DataReference::revised_by_refetch from the served hash, length and etag. The log, the revision metric and the ledger all move in one pass.
rows.remains: The check says a historical query re-fetches; no binary builds a connector-backed historical window or backtest, so re-fetch still runs only on the deep-brain cadence. A deployed deep brain also meets the default-deny egress rule (owner decision).
mutations: connectors.rs, replaced platform.record_reference(revised, at)? with a no-op; failing line: "a revised extent found by a re-fetch was not recorded on the log"

rows.what: Tick-lake retention rights can now be read per venue as well as per licensing class (venue entry decides first, both directions), set through venue/<name>=canonical|none in QIP_DEEPBRAIN_TICK_LAKE_RETENTION.
rows.remains: Retention of the platform's own records is still a constant (raw_retention_permitted false) rather than conditioned on legal and policy obligations; no obligation source is specified and none was invented. No deployment sets the variable (owner decision).
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-storage --test tick_capture; cargo test -p qip-deepbrain --lib connectors
mutations: tick_capture.rs, swapped venue/class lookup order; failing line: "XNAS was kept although its own right keeps nothing"
connectors.rs, dropped duplicate-venue refusal; failing line: lake("venue/coinbase=canonical,venue/coinbase=none").is_err()

rows.what: ClassCheckedStore checks every write to the knowledge-pack store as a compact KnowledgePack before it reaches the inner store, applied by ConnectorArm::with_knowledge_packs, so a document body cannot be kept as a pack.
rows.remains: Only the knowledge-pack class has a checkable content shape; other blob classes pass through unchecked. The pack store is still behind QIP_DEEPBRAIN_KNOWLEDGE_PACKS (owner/egress decision).
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-storage --test class_checked; cargo test -p qip-deepbrain --lib
mutations: class_checked.rs, disabled the KnowledgePacks branch; failing line: "a document body was kept as a pack"

rows.what: assess_sources now journals one SourceScouted frame per pass (new topic, ADR 0626) carrying each candidate's novelty (the finder's uniqueness score); ScoutChecks can disable it, which records None.
rows.remains: Novelty is the finder's uniqueness term, not a separate Scout Fabric run; the discovery desk is off in every committed environment (tfvars flip and cognition-zone egress are owner decisions). Only qip-kernel's scout_record, source_lifecycle, references and lib suites were run; the other kernel integration suites were not (disk allowance exhausted by link output), the pipeline must run them.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-kernel --test scout_record; cargo test -p qip-events
mutations: platform.rs, removed the journal_scout_verdicts call; failing line: "the pass is not on the log: []"
scout_record.rs, forced access_rights on; failing at scout_record.rs:251 (access: Some(..))

rows.what: The same SourceScouted frame records every candidate's access-rights verdict (host, robots, licensing, overall) including first-pass refusals that never register; a disabled check records None, so disabling changes the recorded outcome.
rows.remains: Discovery cadence stays off in committed environments (ADR 0180 / 0157 owner decision), so no default-path scout run writes it; same unrun kernel suites as R12-DATA-1102.
rows.test_command: cargo test -p qip-kernel --test scout_record; cargo test -p qip-events
